task.description: Independently validate the REQ-231 design artefact: scan for disguised executable code, verify researched claims against real source (Letflow.Api.Authorization, Letflow.Secrets.Redaction, tenant_fixture.ex), verify cursor codec design against real Letflow.Api.Pagination, verify redaction sentinel reasoning, confirm acceptance-criteria traceability, confirm no scope creep.

result.note: Exhaustive scan (defmodule, def/defp, schema "...", Enum.*, fn ->, case/cond/with do, |>) of lib/letflow/design/req231-entity-query-cursor-field-grants.md found zero real executable code -- every backtick-quoted expression (Repo.all(query, prefix: prefix), Map.fetch!(row, column_atom), Ecto.Query.dynamic/2, the LEFT JOIN description) is a single named-function or SQL-semantics reference used as prose vocabulary, never chained into copy-pastable control flow. Independently verified against source: lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex confirms evaluate_access/2 is a pure 2-arg function returning exactly :Allow/:Deny403/:AllowWithRowFilter, INV-2's 'no third parameter' text matches verbatim, and role/permission/endpoint_policy_key closed enums have no field/column concept -- design's conclusion holds. lib/letflow/secrets/redaction.ex confirms a global, identity-blind key-name denylist with no user_id, string "[REDACTED]" sentinel (design correctly reuses the key-retained convention but justifies its own distinct atom sentinel against JSON's lack of a bare-atom type). test/support/tenant_fixture.ex's @expected_tenant_tables confirms no existing field-grant table. lib/letflow/api/pagination.ex confirms encode_cursor/1, decode_cursor/4, Cursor.t() (single inner field), Page.t(item), build_raw_cursor/3, build_raw_cursor_timestamp_key/4 all exist as claimed; reusing the outer envelope for a generic JSON-array multi-column resume key is a coherent generalization of list_definitions/2's real two-column tuple-comparison idiom (lib/letflow/entities/definitions.ex lines 277-362, read and confirmed matching). All 5 acceptance criteria traced to specific sections in doc §7, including AC3 naming both modules read with concrete findings in §3.1. git diff --stat 80f650bc..HEAD shows only the two handoff JSONs and the design doc -- no route/controller, no REQ-230 file (types.ex/allowlist.ex/compiler.ex) touched. PASS -- no gaps found.
